purpose: Append-only structured record of operational facts for later evaluation, memory, debrief, investigation and career systems.

fields.recorded_at: optional timestamp if recording is delayed relative to occurrence
fields.actor_refs: characters/systems that performed, issued, acknowledged or produced the event
fields.subject_refs: orders, operations, results, contacts, packages, systems, locations or other entities the event concerns
fields.causal_refs: optional prior event/order/action/result references that explain why this event occurred
fields.payload: small event-specific structured facts; large domain objects remain referenced, not copied
fields.provenance: system/process/operator source responsible for recording this event
fields.visibility: initial access/knowledge projection metadata governed by visibility_projection_rules.json
fields.correction_of_event_id: optional reference when this event corrects a prior assertion without rewriting it
fields.supersedes_event_id: optional reference when a later operational record supersedes an earlier operational record

rules: Events are append-only after acceptance into authoritative history.
The log records facts and references; it does not assign performance grades, relationship changes or moral judgements.
Domain objects such as sensor results remain authoritative in their own subsystem and are referenced by id.
Creating an event does not imply that every NPC, department or player-facing interface knows it.
A correction is a new event referencing the earlier event; historical records are not silently mutated.
Event payloads must not expose unrevealed authoritative world truth.
Actor identity and responsibility must remain distinguishable from the subject of an action.
Issued orders, execution, results and reports should be linkable through stable references.
